note: Material system for the game map. Every surface has a material; the material decides how it sits (snap-to-terrain) and which surface wins where two overlap (higher 'layer' is on top).

concrete.role: building bottom face (foundation); snaps the building to its terrain pad

roadbed.role: road bottom face; carries the road's ground profile

asphalt.role: road top/driving surface; ground + road_lift, always on top of grass

snap_rules.buildings: bottom face (concrete) placed at the footprint's terrain pad height; foundation skirt extends 'skirt' meters below the pad to the lowest ground under the ring
snap_rules.roads: bottom face (roadbed) follows the stored ground profile point-for-point; top face (asphalt) = ground + road_lift
